alt: Apple promotional image showing a Mac, iPad, iPhone, and Apple Watch all running iOS 26's Liquid Glass interface — a translucent, blurry UI redesign so unpopular Apple is adding a slider to turn it off
story: Apple's 'Liquid Glass' redesign in iOS 26 was so roundly rejected that only 15% of iPhone users upgraded (vs 63% for iOS 18), and at WWDC 2026 this week Apple is quietly announcing a system-wide slider so users can dial down — or off — their own flagship design.
why_funny: Apple spent years building a translucent UI so beautiful it needs a dimmer switch to make it usable.
